title: Cell source translation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T,t,r$ be natural numbers, $	au$ a work-tape index, and $ho$ an assignment of natural numbers to the eleven registers. Let $$ be a list of bit sources of length $N$. Suppose the instruction register gives the index of cell $(t,	au,r)$, the preceding-cell register gives the index of cell $(t-1,	au,r)$ whenever $t\ne 0$, and the first-instruction register equals $t$ times the configuration stride. Then translating the cell source list for time $t$ and position $r$ through $ho$ yields exactly the bit-source list for cell $(t,\tau,r)$, with the specified constants and neighbor, current-cell, and snapshot sources in their prescribed order.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
